H1-P1.a: Most people building community go about it in the wrong order. They get the land first, then write the vision down in a document, then let whoever had the money end up owning it. And the emotional preparation? They'll do that later, when everyone has more time.
H1-P1.b: Most people building community take the steps in the wrong order. Sound familiar? First they get the land. Then the vision goes in a document, and the ownership piles up with whoever had the money. The emotional preparation? That waits until everyone has more time.

H2-P3.a: The inner pl/ork can start right where you live, though. [Peer counseling](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling) only needs two people and enough privacy to talk. And reparenting, somatic work, jealousy, conflict repair, etc etc? None of that has to wait for a deed!
H2-P3.b: The inner pl/ork can start right where you live. [Peer counseling](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling) only needs two people and enough privacy to talk. And reparenting, somatic work, jealousy, conflict repair, etc etc can happen pretty much anywhere. No deed required!

new.H2-P6: Trust me on this one. If three households keep showing up for each other like this for six months, you'll learn more than you would from another year of daydreaming about the ideal village.
new.H3-P4: Where can you find them? Maybe at an unprogrammed Quaker meeting, or a restorative-practice group. Open-hearted congregations, mature recovery groups and meditation groups are worth a try too. And look for the people who came back from a long retreat kinder, rather than more impressed with themselves!
new.H3-P5: Then go visit actual communities! [Twin Oaks](https://twinoaks.org/), [East Wind](http://eastwind.org/) and [Acorn](https://www.ic.org/directory/acorn-community-farm/) take visitors, and so do other [intentional communities](https://www.ic.org/) and a lot of [ecovillages](https://ecovillage.org/). Ever been to one? Just check their current visitor requirements first.
new.H3-P6: What do you get out of a visit? Things no manifesto can tell you. How much togetherness you actually enjoy, for one, and what kind of privacy you need. Or which labor system drives you nuts! And whether communal showers feel liberating or send you off pricing studio apartments.
